about: Hand-curated study content merged into patente.db by Scripts/build_content_db.py. 'examLanguage' words decide VERO/FALSO; 'roadWords' are high-value multi-word road terms; 'contrasts' are near-miss concept pairs the exam exploits.

examLanguage.example: non è consentito = it is not allowed
examLanguage.note_en: A tiny word that reverses the whole statement.
examLanguage.note_zh: 一个小词就能让整句意思反转。

examLanguage.note_en: Absolute words often make a statement false — check for exceptions.
examLanguage.note_zh: 绝对化的词常让陈述为假——先找例外。

examLanguage.example: non si può mai = one may never
examLanguage.note_en: Check for exceptions before choosing VERO.
examLanguage.note_zh: 选 VERO 之前先想有没有例外。

examLanguage.example: solo in caso di = only in case of
examLanguage.note_en: Also appears as soltanto and solamente.

examLanguage.example: il conducente deve = the driver must

examLanguage.note_en: Permission or possibility is weaker than obligation.

examLanguage.example: è vietato sorpassare = overtaking is forbidden
è obbligatorio usare = it is mandatory to use
salvo diversa segnalazione = unless otherwise signed
examLanguage.note_zh: 例外决定规则是否成立。

examLanguage.example: massa superiore a = mass greater than
è, di norma, vietato = is normally forbidden
examLanguage.note_en: Not the same as sempre: exceptions exist.

examLanguage.example: in prossimità dell'incrocio = near the junction
prima del pericolo = before the danger
dopo il segnale = after the sign

roadWords.note_en: Not a lane and not a pavement.
roadWords.note_zh: 既不是车道，也不是人行道。

roadWords.note_en: Driver stays present and ready to leave.
roadWords.note_zh: 驾驶员在场、随时可以开走。

roadWords.note_en: Not parking and not a voluntary stop.
roadWords.note_zh: 既不是泊车，也不是主动停车。

roadWords.example: in prossimità del passaggio a livello
il segnale raffigurato = the sign shown
roadWords.note_en: Picture-frame word: it only points at the image.

contrasts.zh: 道路 / 车行道 / 车道
contrasts.text_en: The strada is the whole road infrastructure; the carreggiata is the part for vehicle traffic; a corsia is one longitudinal lane inside it.
contrasts.text_zh: strada 指整个道路设施；carreggiata 是供车辆通行的部分；corsia 是车行道内的一条纵向车道。

contrasts.zh: 交通停车 / 临时停车 / 泊车
contrasts.text_en: Arresto is forced by traffic; fermata is a very short voluntary stop with the driver present; sosta lasts longer and the driver may leave.
contrasts.text_zh: arresto 是交通原因被迫停车；fermata 是驾驶员在场的极短主动停车；sosta 时间更长，驾驶员可以离开。

contrasts.text_en: Sorpasso changes position relative to another moving road user; superamento can describe passing a stationary obstacle without the full overtaking manoeuvre.
contrasts.text_zh: sorpasso 是相对另一行驶中的道路使用者改变位置；superamento 可指绕过静止障碍物，不构成完整的超车动作。

contrasts.text_en: Pericolo concerns safety risk; intralcio concerns impeding the normal flow of traffic. A behaviour may cause either or both.
contrasts.text_zh: pericolo 涉及安全风险；intralcio 指妨碍正常交通流。一种行为可能造成其一或两者。

contrasts.zh: 主要 / 次要城外道路
contrasts.text_en: They have different construction rules and default speed limits: normally 110 km/h versus 90 km/h for cars.
contrasts.text_zh: 两者建设标准和默认限速不同：小汽车通常分别为 110 km/h 和 90 km/h。

contrasts.zh: 临时停车 / 静止停放
contrasts.text_en: In quiz language, fermata is the driver's voluntary short stop; stazionamento is a broader physical state of not moving.
contrasts.text_zh: 在题目语言中，fermata 是驾驶员主动的短暂停车；stazionamento 泛指车辆静止不动的状态。

contrasts.zh: 法定优先 / 实际优先
contrasts.text_en: Legal priority never removes the duty to avoid a collision. A driver may need to yield in practice even when legally entitled to proceed.
contrasts.text_zh: 法定优先权从不免除避免碰撞的义务。即使依法可以先行，实际中也可能需要让行。

contrasts.zh: 总质量 / 空载质量 / 载重量
contrasts.text_en: Gross mass is vehicle plus load; tare is the unladen vehicle; payload is the permitted difference available for people or goods.
contrasts.text_zh: 总质量是车辆加载荷；tara 是空车质量；portata 是可用于载人或载货的允许差值。

contrasts.text_en: Visibility is how far conditions allow you to see; field of view is the area the driver can see, affected by vehicle shape and blind spots.
contrasts.text_zh: 能见度是环境允许看到的距离；视野是驾驶员能看到的范围，受车身形状和盲区影响。

contrasts.zh: 附着力 / 行驶稳定性
contrasts.text_en: Aderenza is tyre-road friction; tenuta di strada is the vehicle's overall ability to follow the intended path.
contrasts.text_zh: aderenza 是轮胎与路面的摩擦；tenuta di strada 是车辆保持预定行驶轨迹的整体能力。

contrasts.zh: 民事 / 刑事 / 行政责任
contrasts.text_en: Civil liability concerns compensation; criminal liability concerns offences; administrative liability concerns sanctions such as fines or licence measures.
contrasts.text_zh: 民事责任涉及赔偿；刑事责任涉及犯罪；行政责任涉及罚款或驾照处罚等制裁。

contrasts.zh: 吊销 / 暂扣 / 收缴
contrasts.text_en: Revocation ends the licence; suspension temporarily removes validity; withdrawal is the immediate material taking of the document by an authority.
contrasts.text_zh: revoca 使驾照失效终止；sospensione 暂时取消其效力；ritiro 是执法机关当场收走证件。
